Actor Rajpal Yadav faces legal action over bounced cheque case

Actor Rajpal Yadav has been ordered to pay over ₹7.35 crore in a cheque bounce case. The Delhi High Court ruled against him, stating that the law must be followed. The case involves a loan taken by Yadav and his wife from a businessman, which was allegedly repaid through a bounced cheque. Yadav has reportedly stated he is willing to go to jail rather than pay the amount.
